name: Sprint

universe.stocks: liquid US stocks, average volume over 5M shares a day
universe.options: long calls and puts only, defined risk, at most 45 days to expiry
universe.events: Kalshi contracts with an edge of at least 5 points after the spread

rules: Every trade states thesis, entry, stop, target and a time-based exit.
Daily loss stop: once the book is down dailyLossStopPct from the start-of-day NAV, open no new risk that day.
Drawdown halt: at drawdownHaltPct below the high-water mark, stop trading and review with the user.
Fills at the ask (buys) and bid (sells). Never chase the target by sizing up after a loss.
